time_representation: Integer scheduled arrival seconds after local service-day midnight, retaining hours >=24. Null means unserved or unresolved; stop_time_status distinguishes them. These are published references, not observations.

geometry_provenance.caveat: The shape API accepts direction_id in the inspected official frontend and exposes no verified historical date selection. This is geometry as retrieved, not proven geometry for the timetable service date.

matching_proof.method: At every non-timing stop, find a complete bipartite matching between published arrivals and trips whose adjacent timing anchors enclose each arrival. Remove each matched edge individually and recompute maximum matching. Only forced associations are exposed; ambiguous cells remain null. This does not assume chronological trip order or use headsigns to force a match.
assumptions: Each per-stop published occurrence belongs to one route trip in this explicit service and direction.
The route trip's anchor stop sequences support a contiguous portion of the common direction stop list; every stop's exact count and headsign multiset independently agrees with those served ranges.
An intermediate scheduled reference lies between its adjacent route timing-point arrivals.

limits: The timetable is date-resolved; the stop list and shape are snapshots from their recorded retrieval times. Historical shape pinning is unverified.
Per-stop responses omit trip_id. Intermediate trip identity is derived only where the complete timing-window assignment is unique under the documented assumptions.
Only six stops are designated timing points. Other published reference times have an undocumented interpolation method. Equal arrival/departure references are not measured zero dwell.
No outbound native SUMO replay, observed vehicle passages, road calibration, passenger demand, vehicle blocks, layovers or interactions with other routes are established by this bundle.
The API service_days flags are false/null despite the date-resolved service. The explicit services?date response is the date authority.
